result.title: Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT): Evidence-Based Text Generation via a Closed-Loop Retrieve--Reflect--Revise Pipeline on Edge LLMs
result.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures. Extended technical account; a related brief report based on overlapping work has been submitted to Frontiers in Disaster and Emergency Medicine. The two manuscripts do not represent independent empirical studies
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent outputs that lack source support or conflict with local operational constraints. We introduce Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT), a modular architecture that organizes generation as a closed Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop. SRCoT separates environment state, persistent knowledge, accumulated experience, and short-term memory into provenance-labeled stores. BM25 retrieval supplies local context; subsequent passes expose intermediate drafts, missing-information markers, follow-up queries, and optional claim--evidence mappings. These artifacts inform retrieval, revision, clarification, or abstention decisions. We examine the architecture through qualitative, trace-based case studies in two fully synthetic settings: emergency medical services and Munich-Sim, an emergency-operations simulation. Local prototype runs on an Apple M4-family laptop with 128 GB memory illustrate source-labeled documentation, explicit gap marking, and structured dispatch-style outputs. The traces also reveal provenance-assignment errors, incomplete evidence coverage, and unsafe assumptions that remain possible despite prompting constraints. These cases demonstrate report-level inspectability and local execution, not comparative superiority, hallucination reduction, clinical validity, or operational safety. The architecture separates retrieval and control from the model interface, but behavior across different models remains to be evaluated. SRCoT is a research proof of concept requiring human review, with its principal contribution lying in an inspectable control procedure rather than a new model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SRCoT，一种将生成组织为 Retrieve–Reflect–Revise 闭环的模块化架构：把环境状态、持久知识、经验与短期记忆分入带来源标签的存储，用 BM25 提供本地上下文，并在多轮中暴露中间草稿、缺失信息标记与可选的主张—证据映射，以支持修订、追问、澄清或弃答；仅在两个合成场景（急救医疗与 Munich-Sim）上做定性轨迹案例分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本闭环中的证据覆盖、来源标注与弃答/停止决策，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 控制提供可核查的方法线索；但其自述仅为概念验证，无比较性结论，迁移到多模态推理仍需人工判断。
